issues.description: filters='*.exe' breaks file picker on macOS and Linux where conda has no extension
issues.detail: In confpage.py the browse dialog is restricted to '*.exe' files. On macOS/Linux the conda/mamba/micromamba binaries have no extension, so users won't be able to pick them via the file dialog. Use platform-aware filters or 'All files (*)' as a fallback.

issues.description: validate_conda substring match is too loose and can accept unrelated binaries
issues.detail: Checking `if any(tool in out.decode().lower() for tool in ['micromamba','mamba','conda'])` will match any binary whose --version output happens to contain 'conda' (e.g., 'anaconda-client'). Match the leading token (e.g., out.startswith('conda ') / 'mamba ' / 'micromamba ') or parse the version line precisely.

issues.description: Custom conda path is not validated at kernel-launch time
issues.detail: kernelspec.py reads conda_path from config and uses it directly without calling validate_conda or checking the file exists/is executable. A stale or invalid configured path will be passed downstream to conda_version() and the activation script, producing a confusing failure rather than the friendly preferences-pointing error.

issues.description: create_browsefile passes validate_callback/validate_reason without verifying create_lineedit accepts them
issues.detail: The diff threads new kwargs through create_browsefile into create_lineedit but the PR only shows the browsefile signature change. If create_lineedit does not already accept validate_callback/validate_reason, this will raise TypeError at config-page setup. Confirm the receiving signature was updated in a prior PR or include the change here.

issues.description: Unconditional setFocus after file selection may surprise users and shift tab order
issues.detail: In select_file, edit.setFocus() is now called whenever a filename is chosen, affecting every browsefile widget across preferences, not just the conda path. This is a global behavior change tucked inside a feature PR; consider scoping it or noting it explicitly.

issues.description: run_program output may go to stderr, not stdout, for some conda variants
issues.detail: validate_conda only inspects stdout from `--version`. Some tools print version info to stderr, which would make validation falsely fail. Combine stdout+stderr, or inspect both streams before deciding.

review.summary: The PR cleanly wires a new "custom Conda executable" preference through config, the maininterpreter config page, and the kernelspec fallback path, with a helper validate_conda. Main concerns: the file dialog filter is Windows-only ('*.exe'), the validator's substring matching is too permissive, and the custom path is trusted at kernel-launch time without re-validating. Smaller issues include unconditional setFocus changing global browsefile behavior and stderr-only version output being ignored. Verify create_lineedit actually accepts the new validate_callback/validate_reason kwargs added to create_browsefile.
